svg.title: Ford circles in the Farey gap between the two fractions a over b and c over d that bracket the 240-term window for 3 minus 2S, after a change of variable that makes the two equal: they fill the disc's two halves. The red circle is their mediant, the largest circle in the gap, with denominator b plus d, one more than Q0; the red arc of the rim is the window, and every circle touching the rim inside it, outlined in red, is smaller. Beside it, the same circles at their true proportions, the window drawn on the line under the red circle.
